observed_datasheet_conditions.reading: Official PDF readable via web extraction; raw bytes could not be retained. These are locked conditional observations, not PASS facts.

population.note: One dual-path package per precision output; one main-switch package per general output. One per reference is a budget sensitivity only; orientation and protection of both endpoint partial states are unproved.

open_obligations: Retain actual datasheet/UG PDF bytes; web-observed rows do not replace local evidence retention.
No tabulated +/-12 V dual Ron, leakage, current or release guarantee; operation/headroom alone is not a full performance certificate.

Datasheet p28 explicitly requires a GND reference always present for proper power-off operation. No independently observable all-rail/reference/local-GND permit circuit exists; this IC alone cannot establish the local-GND-loss obligation.
Keep998ohm on the external side of S. Moving it to D exposes internal drain rail clamps to unbounded pre-release jack current.
Internal D-to-DFB feedback is described for powered disable/fault; its resistance, closure skew and availability during arbitrary rail collapse need evidence.
100nF bypass identity exists but effective capacitance under bias/temperature and installed impedance are not primary-qualified.
Leakage from S/SFB into supply/GND, floating-rail source injection and reachable capacitance require full worst-case evidence; typical source/floating-drain leakage is not a bound.
The16-cell precision loop, all66 general outputs including six0..8V ENV outputs and all30 references require full transfer/thermal/transient qualification before replication.
The conditional ledger retains all auxiliary allowances but cannot bound unsourced +/-12V IC currents, bypass leakage, permit-driver demand or reference orientation overhead.
No native CAD, switching/loop transient model or bench qualification; original1ms/1mV/2mV/10% targets and all original rail/current/drop limits remain unchanged.
